name: HEXAR_CONFIRMATORY_FAILURE
independent_unit: independently generated robot episode (physical or simulated)
aggregation: any of nine fixed query/evidence cells fails; byte-identical requests share one generated output and scoring disposition, giving six unique requests per episode/method under the audited interface
job_failure: any unsupported/contradicted material proposition OR overlicensed diagnostic specificity OR missing required useful outcome/available bounded diagnostic unit
required_units: Reported software navigation outcome and explicit timeout/abort; at least one available bounded diagnostic in the fixed OR group; substantive sampled odometry observation when supplied, preserving status/motion together without physical-arrival inference.
missing_labels: least favorable for superiority: contract fails, prompt succeeds; retained in fixed N; report both-direction uncertainty bounds separately
specificity: state/log/software request does not establish unique physical mechanism; definitive negative causation also material
scientific_rationale: whole-recording battery reliability and useful evidence discipline; stricter than mean answer success, selected for the intended reliability claim

rich_interface_development_candidate.candidate_scope: software outcome plus useful bounded diagnostic and sampled odometry unit when available; both observed status and motion must remain communicated; no physical-arrival inference
rich_interface_development_candidate.admission: candidate only; final mandatory units, numeric tolerances and blinded semantic scoring remain unqualified

unique_request_policy.rule: Generate once per unique complete method request within each episode; identical intact/irrelevant aliases share output, failure and evaluation; no cross-episode or cross-method reuse.
